summary: Manual job listing at Vikas's request (hunt is still OFF): 7 backend roles open to India or worldwide remote, mostly Rails and Java product companies. Nothing applied.
problems: LinkedIn, Naukri, Instahyre, Cutshort and Wellfound need your login, so they were not searched (the job-bot on your Mac will cover them). RemoteOK and Remotive direct feeds are blocked from here, so I used We Work Remotely, Work at a Startup, Built In and company career pages. Left out: SupplyHouse (link points to a different job, US work-authorisation wording), SigNoz and Time Doctor (need Go or Node.js, below the 70 match line), staffing firms and consultancies.
